name: Pixel CRT room
doc: A cozy Bayer-dithered pixel-art vaporwave room where a chunky retro CRT television plays the input media with scanlines and onset VHS glitches, dynamically illuminating the walls, checkered floor, potted palm, and bouncing hi-fi spectrum deck.

in.doc: media playing on the CRT television screen

luma.doc: media brightness (drives CRT phosphor bloom and room spill)

edges.doc: media edges (phosphor contour shimmer on onsets)

palette.doc: vaporwave room and window skyline accent palette

zoom.doc: Camera zoom toward the CRT TV

spill.doc: Strength of dynamic TV light spill onto the room

scanlines.doc: CRT scanline and phosphor grille intensity

glitch.doc: Onset VHS tracking tear and chroma split on the TV
